profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Zocdoc
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Bootstrapped the Auth team and defined its vision, strategy, and scope.
Leading various IAAA initiatives across the org to improve Zocdoc's security posture.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Driving the quarter-long effort to harden our event driven pipeline that powers the entire provider backend to ensure zero event drops.
• Co-leading the internship committee to ensure the highest quality in our summer software internship.
• Ramped up my new team on our Availability microservice which I am a domain expert in so we could have a healthy team to be on call for one of the most critical services at Zocdoc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented several ETL pipelines including: batch jobs that involve Scala Spark jobs running on EMRs; event driven data pipelines that involve Kinesis data streams and Lambda processings.
• Built the infrastructure for deploying and scheduling Spark jobs on demand so other developers can focus on writing the transformation logic. More than 5 jobs are currently running on this infrastructure.
• Upgraded our AWS Redis clusters to support one of our most trafficked .NET Core microservice with zero downtime at hundreds of requests/second with sub-hundred millisecond latencies.
• Onboarded and mentored new hires and interns; prepared slides and documented existing architectures to get them up to speed.
• Spun off bits of our legacy C#/.NET monolith into their own Scala microservices with zero application downtime and zero data loss.
• Implemented C#/.NET applications to facilitate information transfer between Zocdoc and numerous PMS's (Epic, Athena, Cerner,...) via REST and SOAP Apis, databases, web requests, and OCR.

positions.title: Tour Guide
positions.description: Led engineering tours for prospective students and their families.

positions.title: Office of the Dean of College Peer Tutoring
positions.description: Peer tutored students in the Integrated Science Curriculum Princeton course.

positions.title: Ecological Biology Research Intern
positions.description:
Created an empirical probability model (Matlab) to predict how the local extinction of Asian elephants
would affect the seed dispersal of three tree species in Buxa Tiger Reserve, India. Co-author of the paper "In the Elephant's Seed Shadow", currently in review for the journal Ecology.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Used machine learning algorithms to recognize 3 different hand gestures with 90% accuracy.  Built a neural net that locates hands in binary images with 97% accuracy, which is used for hand tracking.

company.name: Applied Science and Technology Research Institute

positions.title: Optics Research Intern
positions.description:
Built an adaptive optical self-interference cancellation using slow and fast light tunable delay.
Developed an algorithm in LabView that enables the system to automatically maximize cancellation.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Electrical Engineering; Minoring in Computer Science

projects.title: Princeton Carlab
projects.description: Built an autonomous car that uses a tablet to process the location of a ball and the car will then fetch it.

projects.title: Transcribe
projects.description: Created an app with two other people that does optical character recognition on images of text and stores the resulting text in a MongoDB database.

publications.title: Adaptive Optical Self-Interference Cancellation Using a Semiconductor Optical Amplifier
In the Elephant's Seed Shadow: the prospective of domestic bovids as replacement dispersers of three tropical Asian trees
